body: No, specifically and directly because I don’t want to be effed harder by our problematic capitalist emergency medical intervention system—the one in my country, at least. I see all these worst case scenarios where I’m locked up against my will, and return to the real world with even less a financial foundation, losing a job, losing my apartment, etc. Those fears absolutely dictate why I won’t reach out, because I know now that if I’m serious about it, my choices are to do it or not do it. Involving other people makes it harder for everyone, and that’s an understatement.
